import random

import pytest

from minesweeper import Minesweeper

SIZE = Minesweeper.SIZE
MINE_COUNT = Minesweeper.MINE_COUNT
ALL_CELLS = [(r, c) for r in range(SIZE) for c in range(SIZE)]


def brute_force_adjacency(mines, r, c):
    """Independent recount of adjacent mines (no engine code reused)."""
    n = 0
    for dr in (-1, 0, 1):
        for dc in (-1, 0, 1):
            if dr == dc == 0:
                continue
            nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= nr < SIZE and 0 <= nc < SIZE and (nr, nc) in mines:
                n += 1
    return n


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Seed 7, first click (4,4): deterministic opening region
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def test_seed7_first_click_reveals_pinned_region():
    """Pinned after one verified run: seed=7, click=(4,4) -> 52 cells."""
    game = Minesweeper(seed=7)
    assert not game.started
    game.reveal(4, 4)

    assert len(game.revealed) == 52
    assert game.started
    assert not game.lost
    assert len(game.mines) == MINE_COUNT


def test_seed7_region_identical_across_instances():
    a = Minesweeper(seed=7)
    b = Minesweeper(seed=7)
    a.reveal(4, 4)
    b.reveal(4, 4)
    assert a.revealed == b.revealed
    assert a.mines == b.mines


@pytest.mark.parametrize("seed", [0, 1, 7, 42, 123, "abc"])
def test_first_click_neighborhood_always_safe(seed):
    game = Minesweeper(seed=seed)
    center = (4, 4)
    safe_zone = {center} | set(game._neighbors(*center))
    game.reveal(*center)
    assert game.mines.isdisjoint(safe_zone)
    assert center in game.revealed
    assert not game.lost
    # exactly MINE_COUNT mines placed on the board
    assert len(game.mines) == MINE_COUNT


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Adjacency numbers vs brute-force recount
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def test_adjacency_matches_brute_force_whole_board():
    game = Minesweeper(seed=7)
    game.reveal(4, 4)
    for cell in game.revealed:
        expected = brute_force_adjacency(game.mines, *cell)
        assert game.adjacent_mines(*cell) == expected, f"cell {cell}"


def test_zero_cells_have_no_mine_neighbors():
    game = Minesweeper(seed=7)
    game.reveal(4, 4)
    zeros = [c for c in game.revealed if game.adjacent_mines(*c) == 0]
    assert zeros  # flood fill actually ran
    for r, c in zeros:
        assert brute_force_adjacency(game.mines, r, c) == 0


def test_flood_fill_boundary_is_complete():
    """Every neighbor of a revealed zero must be revealed too."""
    game = Minesweeper(seed=7)
    game.reveal(4, 4)
    for r, c in game.revealed:
        if game.adjacent_mines(r, c) == 0:
            for nb in game._neighbors(r, c):
                assert nb in game.revealed


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Losing / flagging
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def test_revealing_a_mine_sets_lose():
    game = Minesweeper(seed=1)
    game.reveal(0, 0)          # triggers placement; cannot be a mine
    assert not game.lost
    mine_cell = next(iter(game.mines - game.revealed))
    game.reveal(*mine_cell)
    assert game.lost
    assert not game.won
    assert mine_cell in game.revealed


def test_flag_then_reveal_is_noop():
    game = Minesweeper(seed=7)
    game.reveal(4, 4)          # start the game
    target = next(c for c in ALL_CELLS if c not in game.revealed)

    game.toggle_flag(*target)
    assert game.flagged == {target}

    before = (set(game.revealed), set(game.flagged), game.lost, game.won)
    game.reveal(*target)       # reveal on flagged cell: no-op
    after = (game.revealed, game.flagged, game.lost, game.won)
    assert before[0] == after[0]
    assert before[1] == after[1]
    assert not after[2] and not after[3]

    game.toggle_flag(*target)  # unflag works again
    assert game.flagged == set()


def test_flag_on_revealed_cell_ignored():
    game = Minesweeper(seed=7)
    game.reveal(4, 4)
    cell = next(iter(game.revealed))
    game.toggle_flag(cell)
    assert cell not in game.flagged


# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Scripted full game to win
# --------------------------------------------------------------------- #

def test_scripted_full_game_reaches_win():
    game = Minesweeper(seed=7)
    game.reveal(4, 4)
    assert not game.won

    # Scripted player: flags every mine it knows about (peeking at the
    # engine's mine set is fine for a scripted test), then reveals every
    # remaining safe cell row-major. Flood fill makes many of these no-ops.
    for m in game.mines:
        game.toggle_flag(*m)

    for cell in ALL_CELLS:
        if cell not in game.mines:
            game.reveal(*cell)
            assert not game.lost

    assert game.won
    assert game.revealed == set(ALL_CELLS) - game.mines
    assert game.flagged == game.mines
    assert all(brute_force_adjacency(game.mines, r, c) ==
               game.adjacent_mines(r, c) for r, c in game.revealed)


def test_mine_count_matches_rng_sample_size():
    """Sanity: placement used random.Random(seed) over the full board."""
    rng = random.Random(7)
    expected_pick_count = MINE_COUNT
    picks = rng.sample(range(SIZE * SIZE), expected_pick_count)
    assert len(picks) == expected_pick_count
